subjects.description: A battle-worn knight in battered plate armour over a dark underlayer, wearing a closed visor and a torn cloak; rides with gloved hands on a dragon harness.
A huge black dragon with glossy scales, vast beating wings, and a low rumble; carries the knight low over the battlefield.
A burning battlefield at dusk with broken trenches, shattered siege lines, flames, embers, and drifting smoke.

speakers.description: The battle-worn knight in battered plate armour, speaking over the wind.

claims.text: A knight in battered plate armour rides a huge black dragon low over a burning battlefield.
The target is a 10.125-second, 16:9, 24 fps moving-image sequence.
The battlefield is set at dusk with broken trenches, shattered siege lines, embers, and drifting smoke.
The knight wears a dark underlayer and torn cloak, and the plate is dented and riveted.
The dragon’s black scales are glossy and edged with firelight, and its harness creaks under tension.
